preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 500000, inclusive.
Each edge connects two vertices within the range of vertex numbers.

preconditions.expression: The input represents a correct undirected tree.
preconditions.description: The input graph is a tree, meaning it is connected and has no cycles.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the minimal time required for all ants to be in the root of the tree.

invariants.expression: The ants are initially in the leaves of the tree.
invariants.description: At the start, all ants are located in the leaves of the tree.

invariants.expression: No two ants can be in the same vertex simultaneously except for the root.
invariants.description: During the movement, ants can only move to the parent vertex, and the root can be shared by multiple ants.

invariants.expression: The minimal time is the maximum distance from any leaf to the root.
invariants.description: The minimal time required for all ants to be in the root is determined by the longest path from any leaf to the root.
